plugin: Here There Be Monsters - Curse of Cipactli.esp
rule: Stand-ins for the cell's missing pieces. Every missing piece of this cell is a Dragonborn.esm base that the vault does not hold and the owner excludes, so each ships as a listed gap.

removals.search: Dragonborn.esm is not in the vault (skyrim-source/Data holds Skyrim.esm and Update.esm only) and the owner excludes Dragonborn content (CLAUDE.md asset rule), so the base cannot be resolved to an object; a UESP search for the form id found no page (16k walk 7, places lane, 2026-10-01). With the object unknown, no same-object stand-in (R48) can be chosen.
removals.note: A small household object from Dragonborn stood here. Its record is not in the vault, so the spot stays bare.

removalRule: Owner ruling 2026-10-04 (R113): no missing piece ships as a gap. A missing piece takes a same-class stand-in from a published kit where one exists (substitutions[]); a decorative piece whose class no published kit or vault archive holds is taken out of the fit-out (removals[], reason decorative-no-same-class, its search recorded), and the spot is simply empty. A placed piece whose only support was a removed piece is removed with it (reason rests-on-a-removal, restsOn naming that row).
